en.title: Wildfire smoke damages airway defenses in Los Angeles study
en.dek: UCLA researchers found wildfire smoke paralyzes cilia and loosens cell seals in human airway tissue.
facts: Wildfire smoke from the Palisades and Eaton fires occurred in Los Angeles in January 2025.
Airway defense normally includes sticky mucus trapping particles and cilia sweeping mucus out.
UCLA researchers found smoke paralyzes cilia and loosens protein seals between airway cells.
Blocking a specific cell signal protected human airway tissue in lab tests.
body: Researchers sampled nasal and sinus tissue from 14 Los Angeles residents who had sinus surgery around the January 2025 fires.
Tissue before the fires showed an intact airway lining, but during the fires, the lining was patchy and protein seals fragmented.
The team tested lab-grown human airway tissue to expose it to smoke, adapting a chamber built for cigarette smoke.
Co-senior author Dr. Brigitte Gomperts stated that small particles that break down the airway barrier can cause inflammation in the brain and heart.
en.context: Wildfire smoke has been linked to lung disease, stroke, heart disease, and cancer, according to the sources.

de.title: Ruß von Waldbränden schädigt Atemwegsverteidigungen in Los-Angeles-Studie
de.dek: UCLA-Forscher fanden heraus, dass Waldbrandrauch die Flimmerhärchen lähmt und Zellverschlüsse in menschlichem Atemwegsgewebe lockert.
facts: Waldbrandrauch von den Bränden Palisades und Eaton traf Los Angeles im Januar 2025
Die Atemwegsverteidigung umfasst normalerweise zähen Schleim, der Partikel einfängt, und Flimmerhärchen, die Schleim nach außen befördern
UCLA-Forscher fanden heraus, dass Rauch Flimmerhärchen lähmt und Protein-Verschlüsse zwischen Atemwegszellen lockert

Blockierung eines spezifischen Zell-Signals schützte menschliches Atemwegsgewebe in Laborversuchen @@CONTEXT__ Waldbrandrauch wurde laut Quellen mit Lungenerkrankungen, Schlaganfällen, Herzerkrankungen und Krebs in Verbindung gebracht.
body: Forschende haben Nasen- und Nasennebenhöhlengewebe von 14 Los-Angeles-Bewohnern entnommen, die im Januar 2025 um die Brände einer Nasenoperation unterzogen wurden.
Das Gewebe vor den Bränden wies eine intakte Atemwegsauskleidung auf, während die Auskleidung während der Brände fleckig war und Proteinversiegelungen fragmentiert waren.
Das Team testete menschliches Atemwegsgewebe im Labor und setzte es Rauch aus, wobei es eine Kammer adaptierte, die ursprünglich für Zigarettenrauch gebaut wurde.
Co-Senior-Autorin Dr. Brigitte Gomperts erklärte, dass kleine Partikel, die die Atemwegsbarriere abbauen, Entzündungen im Gehirn und im Herzen verursachen können.

it.title: Il fumo degli incendi danneggia le difese delle vie aeree a Los Angeles, secondo uno studio
it.dek: Ricercatori UCLA hanno scoperto che il fumo degli incendi paralizza i cilie e allenta i sigilli cellulari nei tessuti delle vie aeree umane
facts: Incendi di Palisades ed Eaton a Los Angeles nel gennaio 2025
La difesa delle vie aeree include normalmente muco appiccicoso che intrappola particelle e cilie che spazzano via il muco
I ricercatori UCLA hanno scoperto che il fumo paralizza i cilie e allenta i sigilli proteici tra le cellule delle vie aeree

Bloccando un segnale specifico di cellula si è protetto il tessuto delle vie aeree umane in test di laboratorio @@CONTEXT__ Il fumo degli incendi è stato collegato a malattie polmonari, ictus, malattie cardiache e cancro, secondo le fonti @@CAPTION__ """
body: I ricercatori hanno prelevato tessuto nasale e sinusale da 14 residenti di Los Angeles sottoposti a chirurgia sinusale in seguito agli incendi di gennaio 2025.
Il tessuto pre-incendi presentava una mucosa delle vie aeree integra, mentre durante gli incendi la mucosa era frammentata e i sigilli proteici erano danneggiati.
Il team ha testato tessuto umano delle vie aeree coltivato in laboratorio esponendolo al fumo, adattando una camera originariamente pensata per il fumo di sigaretta.
La co-autrice senior, la dottoressa Brigitte Gomperts, ha dichiarato che le piccole particelle che compromettono la barriera delle vie aeree possono causare infiammazioni nel cervello e nel cuore.

zh.title: 加州大学洛杉矶分校研究：山火烟雾会破坏呼吸道防御机制
zh.dek: 加州大学洛杉矶分校的研究人员发现，山火烟雾会导致人体呼吸道组织中的纤毛瘫痪，并使细胞间的密封结构松动。
facts: 2025年1月，洛杉矶发生了帕利塞德（Palisades）和伊顿（Eaton）山火，产生了大量烟雾。
呼吸道的正常防御机制包括利用黏液捕捉颗粒物，并通过纤毛将黏液排出。
加州大学洛杉矶分校的研究人员发现，烟雾会使纤毛瘫痪，并削弱呼吸道细胞间的蛋白质密封连接。
在实验室测试中，阻断特定的细胞信号可以起到保护人体呼吸道组织的作用。
body: 研究人员从14名于去年1月左右接受鼻窦手术的洛杉矶居民那里采集了鼻腔和鼻窦组织样本。
手术前的组织显示气道内层完整，但在火灾期间，内层出现斑驳，蛋白质密封结构出现碎片化。
团队利用适配香烟烟雾实验室的装置，对培养的有人类气道组织进行了烟雾暴露实验。
共同高级作者布里吉特·戈姆珀茨博士表示，会破坏气道屏障的微小颗粒可导致大脑和心脏发炎。
zh.context: 据相关资料显示，山火烟雾已与肺部疾病、中风、心脏病和癌症的发生存在关联。

problemsFixed: Headline uses an evaluative verb ('paralyzes') and is not a purely factual statement of what happened.
Dek is not a single-sentence summary and uses loaded language ('attacks').

The body contains unsupported claims or unattributed interpretations (e.g., 'according to a UCLA study published in Environmental Health Perspectives'—the source only states the findings were published there, not that the study itself was published there in that manner).
The body uses jargon ('cement') without inline explanation, although the source does explain the structure.
The context uses speculative language ('potentially reach') and frames the issue as a 'growing concern' without direct attribution of that framing.
The structure violates rhythm rules (e.g., short declarative sentences in a row) and paragraph opening rules (starting with the actor/date/number, not the same noun as the previous paragraph).
The draft includes filler and evaluative framing ('a vivid example of a growing problem').
